reason: B is the stronger proposal because dislocation pile-up and back-stress at coherent B2/L12 interfaces are physically plausible under rapid loading and can be tested by systematically varying interface density while measuring dynamic strength and interfacial dislocation accumulation. A is more novel, but stress-driven atomic reordering at ambient temperature on ~10⁻³ s loading timescales is kinetically implausible, and its annealed-versus-as-cast comparison does not isolate lattice distortion or SRO.
